entries.title: Product Constitution
canonicalRules: Product, business, user-loop, trust, and brand constraints live here.
blockedPatterns: old economy iconography as user-facing GumDrop value

entries.title: Source-Of-Truth Constitution
canonicalRules: contract -> server truth -> client projection -> UI display -> telemetry -> validator -> docs

entries.title: Engineering Constitution
canonicalRules: Agents read compact context first.
Do not read every Markdown file by default.
Broad audits are forbidden by default.
blockedPatterns: read every md file by default
full npm run check as first command

entries.title: admin-ai surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Admin AI uses shared model registry and budget controls.

entries.title: admin-debug surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Admin debug labels live/cached/stale/fallback/partial/failed/unknown.
Generated reports remain snapshots.

entries.title: behavioral-intelligence surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Raw events normalize before scoring.
Deterministic ranking remains safety baseline.

entries.title: cloud/sql/bigquery surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Data Connect and Cloud SQL remain agent-context mirror unless explicitly promoted.

entries.title: creator-dashboard surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Creator paid experiences use paid-source GumDrops where required.
Expected failures return typed safe errors.

entries.title: creator-profile surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Fan profile actions target creators without becoming creator behavior.

entries.title: device-ui surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Use shared device layout and mobile shell helpers.

entries.title: drops surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Full-page locked preview is canonical.
Unlocks count server entitlement facts only.

entries.title: image-loading surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Use surface-based image policy and accurate sizes.

entries.title: moderation surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Screenshot-like signals remain weak heuristic context unless confirmed by platform/server evidence.

entries.title: security/cost surface doctrine
canonicalRules: API routes declare auth, origin, rate, idempotency, cache, cost, and failure contracts.

entries.title: support surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Bug reports and support tickets feed user timeline and debug evidence.
blockedPatterns: admin support reply counted as user behavior

entries.title: Surface Doctrine Index
canonicalRules: Each surface has exactly one canonical authority-level-4 doctrine doc.
blockedPatterns: two canonical docs for one surface

entries.title: telemetry surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Actor ids identify performer and target ids identify affected entity.
Server truth anchors purchase and unlock metrics.
blockedPatterns: creator_id as actorCreatorId for fan action

entries.title: user-management surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Admin user metrics read normalized user facts.
Admin cards label source state honestly.
blockedPatterns: admin QA counted as user behavior

entries.title: viewer surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Visible media emits file_viewed with viewerSessionId.
File views connect to watch sessions.

entries.title: wallet surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Revenue and user value read server purchase or ledger transaction truth.
Wallet preserves paid vs reward GumDrop source accounting.

entries.title: watch-time surface doctrine
canonicalRules: Watch time is foreground visible engagement.
Behavioral intelligence prefers watch-session rollups.
blockedPatterns: page duration as canonical watch time
